scope: 473 exact raw positions; all12 native fields; primary N/E and mandatory OUTSIDE/S/W exact recurrences

account_top.status: Honest whole-account decision, e.g. PARTIAL; coverage PASS does not establish complete construction
account_top.constructor_sha256: SHA256 of immutable initial constructor file
account_top.rows: One row per native source_group_id; source order recommended
account_top.dictionary: Assigned exact wholes with stable entry_id, raw_form, fixed rule/value/arguments policy, explicit costs; unknown forms may also be listed
account_top.primary_units: N and E records for each reader: native IDs/count, status, first barrier, complete boolean
account_top.costs: Separate initial core families/constants and paid extensions/aliases/defaults/ambient inputs/unknown carry/unused instructions; unweighted counts
account_top.shared_part_uses: Actual licensed aN use rows and arguments/returned values/consumers; non-null effect declaration stays manually reviewable

row_format.native: Prefer flat unchanged12 fields; nested native/source/source_raw is acceptable with all12 fields preserved. Additional derived fields must not replace native bytes.
row_format.entry_id: Declared dictionary ID or null for UNKNOWN
row_format.arguments: Typed IDs or compact typed values with producer_source_ids, if available
row_format.consumer_source_ids: Actual referring source IDs or terminal retention/instruction declaration
row_format.cost: Priced rule/root/residual/reference contributions or dictionary cost reference
row_format.delta: Optional compact effects; full state duplication not required

dictionary_policy: All assigned raw_form entries cover every exact occurrence in all473 rows, including context barriers; entry identity survives blocked execution. Typed overloads require explicit finite conditions/costs. Report countercases without replacing native literals.
shared_part_limits: Require actual declared shared operation on at least two exact licensed forms among aiin/daiin/shodaiin. Bare aiin is a root. Nonempty declarations/reference existence are checkable; semantic license/type/non-null truth is manual.
receipts: Initial/final receipt files map repository-relative artifact paths to SHA256; root separately releases final account and initial freeze hashes before validator reads author content.
schema_flexibility: Authors may preserve their own compact schema; root coordinates a technical adapter. No forced universal executor or invented interpretation fields.
manual_only: effectiveness of shared parts and consumers

validator_release_format.requirement: Include A,B,C with actual paths; optional receipt paths may differ. Only root releases this map after all authors freeze. No author content read by validator beforehand.
